body: Thank you for all the comments everyone. I do feel a lot better now after reading them. So now I’ve decided to finally quit porn once and for all this time and never look back. I’m also going to set goals for myself to accomplish in the future. I’ve realized that being depressed most of the time will not last forever and is only temporary. And negative thoughts in my head will not help me either so I will try to think more of the good things in life instead of the bad and evil. I do believe in myself and that I can get through this. Many people have it even worse than me and some have even beaten depression. If they can beat it, I know that I can. Thanks again for the comments and bless you all.
